Two programs, each its own download: **Inkt** (word processor, .docx) and **Cel** (spreadsheet, .xlsx). Made by JJ van Schelven.

## Which file do I need?

| Your computer | Inkt | Cel |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows 10 / 11** | `Inkt-…-windows.zip` | `Cel-…-windows.zip` |
| **Ubuntu, Debian, Linux Mint** | `Inkt-…-linux-x64.deb` | `Cel-…-linux-x64.deb` |
| **Fedora, openSUSE** | `Inkt-…-linux-x64.rpm` | `Cel-…-linux-x64.rpm` |
| **Arch, Manjaro, EndeavourOS, other Linux** | `Inkt-…-linux-x64.AppImage` or `.tar.gz` | `Cel-…-linux-x64.AppImage` or `.tar.gz` |

Have an ARM computer (for example a Raspberry Pi 4/5 or an ARM laptop)? Take the files with `arm64` in the name.

Step-by-step instructions: [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/jeltevanschelven8-afk/kantoor-space/blob/main/INSTALL.md)
